answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16080 Country: United Kingdom Title: Assalamu alaikum.Respected Ulama.My question is can I touch my wife's breast when we are keeping Rozah(sawm)? Can I change my clothes infront of my wife? Can she change her clothes infront of me? Can I kiss her on her chick(gaal)? Can she kiss me on my chick(gaal)? Jazakallah Question: Assalamu alaikum.Respected Ulama.My question is can I touch my wife's breast when we are keeping Rozah(sawm)? Can I change my clothes infront of my wife? Can she change her clothes infront of me? Can I kiss her on her chick(gaal)? Can she kiss me on my chick(gaal)? Jazakallah Answer ID: 16080 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1488/1490/M=1430) One can touch breast of wife during fast and they can kiss each other at cheek as well, but if he fears ejaculation or ultimately intercourse, then it is makrooh , it should be avoided. Husband and wife can change dress before one another. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
